text: FIX `RxDocument.patch()` and `incrementalPatch()` with an `undefined` value on a CRDT collection stored the operation as `$set` with an `undefined` value, which is lost when the operation is serialized, so the removed field came back after a conflict resolution and dev-mode threw `SNH` on the next write after a reopen. The field is now removed with a `$unset` operation. Added a testcase
